verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs say apps deploy to any Node.js-compatible environment, either as a standalone Mastra server or inside an existing web framework. Bun, Deno and Cloudflare runtimes are also supported, and the pricing page advertises free self-hosting ('Build and host agents anywhere'). Studio can run locally at localhost:4111, though one deployment-docs line calls it a hosted environment; a community comment also cites Elastic v2 terms against the pricing page's Apache 2.0 claim, but that restricts reselling as a service, not self-hosting. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of a fully self-hosted production deployment, clarity on whether any tooling (e.g. hosted Studio/observability) is required versus optional.
